name: EOD 2026-10-08
body:
> Eod · 2026-10-08

Thursday. Training review plus claim and schema cleanups across all three clients.

# Training (all clients)
- Read both Local Rank Academy courses (Local SEO 21 lessons, AI SEO 14 modules) and mapped what applies to each client. About half the tactics break Google or FTC rules (fake GBP addresses, review gating, paid reviews, CTR manipulation, PBN citation networks, fake Reddit accounts) and were listed as do-not-use.
- Takeaways saved: [Lesson Takeaways 2026-10-08](lib:brain-lesson-takeaways-2026-10-08). A fix-step file was written for each client.

# Summit Plumbing Pros AZ
See [Summit Plumbing Pros AZ (Hub)](lib:brain-summit-plumbing-pros-az-hub).
- Homepage fixes approved by Scott: duplicate H1 fixed (mobile copy now H2), meta cut from 287 to 154 characters, wrong "Article" schema removed (Plumber, WebPage, FAQPage stay).
- Turned on llms.txt via Rank Math (154 pages, 32 posts, verified business facts block).
- Drafted claim fixes for 5 pages. Brand fixes live: "Summit Plumbing" (Utah brand) to "Summit Plumbing Pros" 17 times on water softeners (plus "years of industry experience" removed) and 7 on leaking pipe repair; 3 em dashes removed.

# Pipeliners
See [Pipeliners (Hub)](lib:brain-pipeliners-hub).
- Removed the false "Open 24 hours (24/7)" line from both llms files.
- Found 32 of 52 posts lack Article schema, and 33 city pages carry a hidden 4.9/122 review rating in schema (against Google's rules; real is about 4.99 from 125). Removal decided but on hold until the Google Ads connector is reconnected for the ad check.

# Alphalete Trenchless
See [Alphalete Trenchless (Hub)](lib:brain-alphalete-trenchless-hub).
- Removed unapproved claims from both llms files (20-year warranty, "100% satisfaction guarantee", "Free Video Inspection", warranty FAQ).
- Site schema lists 3 different phone numbers; needs one official number. 49 of 50 posts lack Article schema (planned after Oct 21). Company Avatar saved.

# Follow-ups
- Scott (Summit): Rank Math business details and default schema to None; epoxy and "50+ years" wording on 2 pipe lining pages; /home-warranty-plumbing/ keep, noindex or remove.
- Scott (Pipeliners): GBP shows 24 hours; wrong numbers on Birdeye, Ace DuraFlo and Google's AI answer; Bing Places; homepage schema type.
- Agency owner (Alphalete): official phone, hours, legal name, warranty wording, "free" inspection.
- Reconnect the Google Ads connector, then remove the hidden rating (test page first). Set up Bing Webmaster Tools for all 3; mark generate_lead as a key event in Alphalete GA4.
- Rechecks Oct 15 and Oct 21.
